text:
marta: FYI an urgent customer hit: after we pushed the SAML library security patch (CVE-2025-9999) some SSO assertions started failing and downstream SCIM deprovisioning is tripping. seeing 500s in scim-provisioner.
lee: which patch exactly? i merged the vendored saml2 3.4.1 -> 3.4.2 that changed NameID validation.
marta: exact error from scim-provisioner: `AssertionError: invalid nameid format` in logs, and idp logs show truncated RelayState for some users.
devops-bot: deploy job #848 completed at 2025-02-15T09:12:34Z to prod (marta).
sec-ops: CVE patch is required; but we must triage availability impact. can you paste stack trace?
marta: snippet:
```
2025-02-15T09:18:40Z ERROR scim-provisioner handler: AssertionError: invalid nameid format, user=acct+tag@example.com
  at saml2.validate_nameid (/app/vendor/saml2/core.py:412)
  at handler.process (/app/scim/handler.py:88)
```
lee: looks like the validator now enforces strict emailNameID and rejects plus-addressing. that would explain the deprovision fail.
idp-bot: Alert: 76 failed SAML assertions in last 10m (relaystate-truncated: 18).
oncall_rin: i'm seeing KMS errors around the same window too: `Decrypt failed: AccessDenied` for key alias/redwood-sso. Possibly a separate RBAC/IAM policy change coincided.
sec-ops: confirm if any IAM or key policy updates 09:10-09:20?
devops-bot: IAM change detected: role/infra-ci had inline policy removed at 2025-02-15T09:11:02Z by automation (script: iam-prune).
lee: oh no, that automation pruned permissions to `service-account:ssoweb` which scim-provisioner uses for KMS decrypt.
marta: so two simultaneous issues: stricter NameID validation + SA lost kms:Decrypt -> deprovisioning failing end-to-end.
sec-ops: immediate mitigation options?
lee: quick rollback of saml lib to 3.4.1 in canary to test if NameID validation is the primary blocker.
oncall_rin: i'll re-add kms:Decrypt to service-account:ssoweb for alias/redwood-sso temporarily.
sec-ops: grant for emergency only, add expiry tag and log change. notify infra team to revert iam-prune rule.
marta: i'm enabling a permissive NameID fallback in scim-provisioner that treats unknown formats as `email` for 1 hour. adding warn logs and metrics.
lee: do we have a test vector? create a synthetic SAML assertion with plus-addressing and a RelayState > 512 chars to repro.
idp-bot: Test suggestion posted to INC-4127 ticket.
marta: created INC-4127: 'SAML library patch + IAM prune caused SCIM failures' and attached repro and affected customer list.
oncall_rin: KMS policy restored for service-account:ssoweb at 2025-02-15T09:25:10Z. verifying decrypt success...
devops-bot: KMS decrypt success for service-account:ssoweb at 2025-02-15T09:25:45Z.
marta: re-run backlog deprovision jobs. initial run shows 22 still failing with nameid format; 54 succeeded.
lee: rolling saml lib back in prod to 3.4.1 now for immediate relief. will coordinate a proper compatibility test before reapplying 3.4.2.
sec-ops: follow-up actions:
- lee: add strict compatibility tests for NameID formats to CI (due 1715000800)
- devops: update iam-prune automation to exclude service-account:ssoweb and keys (due 1715000600)
- marta: harden scim-provisioner to validate and return 4xx to IdP for invalid NameID instead of 500 (due 1715001200)
- sec-ops: schedule postmortem and communicate to customers about emergency window (due ASAP)
marta: note: ensure re-encrypt routine uses stable encryption_context across rotations; seen mismatch risk when RelayState trimming occurs before encrypt.
lee: agreed. will add deterministic canonicalization step for NameID before encrypt and a migration plan for any re-encrypt.
marta: thanks all. keep updates in INC-4127 and this thread. ping me if any customer reports new SSO behavior.
